description: This Java source file defines the 'EnterpriseApplication' class which bootstraps an embedded Jetty server, configures it to serve a web application packaged inside a shaded JAR, and manages server lifecycle including startup and graceful shutdown.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class responsible for starting an embedded Jetty server, setting up web application context from classpath resources, and managing server lifecycle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes and starts the Jetty server with web application context, and sets up shutdown hooks.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the TCP port for the Jetty server based on system properties, defaulting to 8090 if unspecified or invalid.
